subject: general
question:
Rita, Suman, Tarun, Uma, Victor and Wendy are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Rita sits third to the right of Suman. Tarun sits second to left of Suman. Uma sits to the immediate left of Rita. Victor is not an immediate neighbour of Tarun.

How many people sit between Suman and Victor when counted from the right of Suman ?
solution:
Given:

Rita, Suman, Tarun, Uma, Victor and Wendy are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Rita sits third to the right of Suman.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95d99465cb22006df17db42755e85934ae4fded65f4bb538306a280cca8f0075.png] 

2) people sit between Suman and Victor when counted from the right of Suman) Tarun sits second to left of Suman.

3) Uma sits to the immediate left of Rita.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1802411030c3d762d43aafcd57776f4a2b789eca3beab556626bda9b63b93bd.png] 

4)Victor is not an immediate neighbour of Tarun.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9f353d7fdfe6595c8c60e35d114921cf0f7df077982a4e3d22c9143df0db0bf.png] 

So, 'Zero' people sit between Suman and Victor when counted from the right of Suman'

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (3)"**
